sections.h2: Portlock Terrace Home Prices and Market Pace
sections.html:
In the 24 months from November 15, 2024 to November 14, 2026, 58 residential sales closed in Portlock Terrace (Chesapeake, VA) according to REIN MLS records. The median sold price was $319,250, below the citywide median of $420,000, and homes took a median of 18 days to sell, about the same pace as the citywide median of 18 days. These figures come from closed sales, which show what homes actually sold for rather than asking prices.

The middle half of Portlock Terrace sales closed between $281,175 and $349,999, or about $204 per square foot against $219 citywide. Split by year, the median sold price in the most recent 12 months ($319,000, 29 sales) was about 2% lower than in the earlier 12 months ($325,000, 29 sales). The typical home sold right at its list price (median sale-to-list ratio of 100%).

Recent Portlock Terrace sales were in ZIP code 23324.

sections.h2: What Stands Out About Portlock Terrace
sections.html: 33% of Portlock Terrace sales had four or more bedrooms, against 53% citywide. 100% of sales here were detached homes, versus 76% citywide. The median Portlock Terrace home is about 1,498 square feet, smaller than the 1,970 square foot citywide median.

sections.h2: When Portlock Terrace Homes Sell and How Far Prices Range
sections.html:

sections.h2: What Kinds of Homes Sell in Portlock Terrace
sections.html:
All of the sales were detached single-family homes. The median home was about 1,498 square feet, with the middle half of sales running from roughly 1,175 to 1,703 square feet. 53% of the homes that sold had 3 bedrooms.

Home ages vary widely here: about 80% of sales were built between 1940 and 2009, with a median year built of 1960.
